systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous High-Shear Slit-Die Extrusion & Hydrodynamic Cavitation Mycoprotein Texturizing Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Sanitary High-Moisture Meat Analogue Texturizing Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 170.36 GRAS / FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 / EHEDG Class I / ISO 22000)
systemArchitectures.technology: Co-Rotating Intermeshing Twin-Screw High-Moisture Extruder (L/D 40:1, screw speed 150–600 rpm, modular shear & conveying kneading blocks) coupled in-line with Multi-Orifice Micro-Hydrodynamic Cavitation Defibrillator (15–35 bar inlet, constriction cavitation number σ 0.18–0.28, shockwave collapse ΔP > 1,500 bar) and Temperature-Regulated Long Cooling Slit-Die (Aspect Ratio W/H > 12:1, length 1,200–2,400 mm, dual-circuit counter-current glycol cooling jackets)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Nitrided DIN 1.8550 / 316L Stainless Steel Barrel Liners with High-Hardness Colmonoy 56 Clad Screw Flights, Hastelloy C-276 Cavitation Venturi Orifices (Ra ≤ 0.20 µm), Mirror-Polished Tool Steel DIN 1.2379 Slit-Die (Hard Chrome Plated, Ra ≤ 0.15 µm), and USP Class VI FFKM Kalrez Gaskets
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: ASME Section VIII Rupture Disc & Proportional Hydraulic Relief Valve (180 bar design pressure), Barrel Over-Torque Electronic Clutch (<5.0 ms shutoff), Die Pressure Transducer Interlock (<120 bar trip), and Continuous Cooling Water Flow Loss Alarms
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship commercial continuous texturizing system for alternative whole-cut protein manufacturing. Directly aligns Fusarium venenatum fungal hyphae through twin-screw shear and long slit-die laminar cooling, while in-line micro-hydrodynamic cavitation defibrillates cell surfaces to induce natural hydrogen bonding and protein entanglement—achieving a high muscle-like anisotropy index (AI > 3.0) with zero methylcellulose or synthetic binders.

systemArchitectures.name: Pilot Modular R&D High-Shear Slit-Die Texturizing Rig

systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished 316L Stainless Steel with Tungsten Carbide Insert Kneading Elements and Hard-Anodized Aluminum Die Blocks (Ra ≤ 0.20 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Fast-Response Dual Mechanical Torque Limiter, Emergency Die E-Stop, and Optical Thermal Cutoff (>155°C)
systemArchitectures.description: Designed for advanced alternative protein formulation laboratories and rapid whole-cut prototype development. Allows precise mapping of hyphal orientation, screw shear profiles, and cavitation-induced micro-fibrillar entanglement across diverse mycelial strains.

systemArchitectures.name: Mega-Scale Continuous Industrial Mycoprotein Whole-Cut Extrusion Plant
systemArchitectures.classification: Heavy Industrial Food Manufacturing Line (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / USDA FSIS Compliant / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 2 / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Capacity Twin-Screw Extruder (L/D 44:1, 133 mm screw diameter, 3,500 kg/h capacity) with Dual Parallel Slit-Dies (3,000 mm cooling length each), Multi-Stage Cavitation Manifold (8-Venturi Array), and Automated Guillotine Cutter & Robotic Tray In-Line Loader

systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Automated Hydraulic Blow-Off Bypass Valve, Dual Seismic Vibration Sensors, High-Speed Infrared Extrudate Flash Detector, and Triple ASME Pressure Redundancy
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for utility-scale commercial production of whole-cut plant/mycelium chicken cutlets, beef tenders, and structured fish fillets. Runs 24/7 continuous duty cycles with automated recipe management and real-time slit-die rheometry feedback.

anisotropyIndex.formula: AI = F_perpendicular / F_parallel = (Cutting Force Perpendicular to Extrusion) / (Cutting Force Parallel to Extrusion)
anisotropyIndex.targetRange: 2.5 to 3.8 (Meat-like range: Chicken breast 2.8–3.4, Beef muscle 2.4–3.2)
anisotropyIndex.explanation: Quantitative measure of unidirectional fiber alignment. Values above 2.0 confirm an authentic fibrous grain structure that shears naturally along fiber bundles.

slitDieShearRate.explanation: Calculates wall shear rate in rectangular slit-die channel where Q is volumetric throughput, W is die width, and H is die gap height.

powerLawFluidViscosity.parameters: K = flow consistency index (Pa*s^n), n = flow behavior index (0.30 - 0.45, strongly pseudoplastic shear-thinning)
powerLawFluidViscosity.explanation: Mycelial pastes demonstrate profound pseudoplastic shear thinning inside the extruder barrel, enabling smooth conveying under high screw rpm while setting into elastic gels during cooling.

hydrodynamicCavitationNumber.threshold: sigma_cav < 0.25 (Incites intense acoustic shockwaves and micro-jet stagnation pressures > 1,500 bar)
hydrodynamicCavitationNumber.explanation: Governs the inception and collapse intensity of cavitation micro-bubbles inside the pre-die orifice plate, inducing surface defibrillation of hyphal walls.

specificMechanicalEnergy.typicalRange: 75 to 110 kWh/ton for HSE-HCT vs 135 to 180 kWh/ton for conventional TVP
specificMechanicalEnergy.explanation: Total mechanical motor work delivered per ton of product, showing a 35-45% energy reduction due to lubrication provided by native mycelial beta-glucans.
